run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the minimum number of squares to cut a paper of given dimensions
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which uses a greedy approach to find minimum squares for paper cutting
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that swaps inputs and iteratively divides to count square cuts
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to add input validation and type hints for the paper dimensions parameters
